name: Hopf Links
desc: Stereographically projected Hopf fibers — great-circle rings of the 3-sphere that link without ever touching, nested into a luminous torus of spectrum-hued glowing loops tumbling in continuous 4D rotation.

density.doc: fiber population (more latitudes & longitudes = denser linked torus)

twist.doc: extra 4D rotation plane — how much the rings shear through each other

hue.doc: base hue the spectrum rotates from
